newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Dairy Crest paints upbeat outlook.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Dairy Crest paints upbeat outlook.

text.p: Britain's Dairy Crest Group Plc, which was floated on the London stock market last August, on Tuesday said it hoped to maintain the "excellent" financial performance it posted in 1996/97 amid a flourishing market for cheddar cheese.

"We spend all of our time driving and working very hard to make sure that the sort of excellent financial performance you have in front of you today is achieved on an ongoing basis," chairman John Houliston told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Dairy Crest, which is the leader in the British market for mature and farmhouse chedder, earlier reported a 17 percent rise in pro forma earnings per share to 22.4 pence.
